author: Smoebo
generator: Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60, image_gen, one call per plate with the prompt recorded here unchanged
purpose: A second and a neutral presentation for each generic role, so a role's plate agrees with the gender its foe carries. The first presentation of each role is recorded in role-plates-2026-11-26.json and mystery-horror-plates-2026-11-26.json, or is an NPC roster plate.
subjectBasis: Original designs of generic roles, per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md. No published illustration or real person was named or supplied as an input.
encoding: Each 1024x1024 JPEG original resized once to 256x256 (cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed at full size and in a round crop at 96px and 40px on dark and light surrounds. Seven neutral plates are second paintings: a prompt asking only for an androgynous person returned a plainly masculine face, so the second prompt covers the face (the guard's aventail, the smuggler's scarf) or asks for features that could be a woman's or a man's.
